scope: Step 1 only: complete semantic review of the 39 recorded logic_v3 cases

rubric_policy.label_correct: Label follows the full context under the existing fixture interpretation. Conditional annotation readings are disclosed separately.
rubric_policy.quote_relevant: Quoted text is exact and pertinent to the decisive assessment or known fact/gap. Mere support for another conjunct does not evidence a contradiction. Joint coverage is evaluated separately.
rubric_policy.explanation_follows_evidence: The explanation is consistent with full context, uses the correct metric/scope, and justifies the verdict; repeating a compound claim does not prove it.
rubric_policy.all_claim_parts_checked: Support covers every material part. Contradict has a logically sufficient in-scope refutation under the correct quantifier. NEI identifies known versus unresolved material parts.
rubric_policy.missing_information_specific: For an unresolved claim the missing facts are identified without unnecessary restrictions or requests for already supplied information.
rubric_policy.not_applicable: Empty quotes on NEI and no missing information on fully decidable claims are stored true for compatibility but excluded from applicable denominators.
rubric_policy.anaphora: Unambiguous these/third/one references can resolve through adjacent context; a quote need not repeat every antecedent. This does not excuse omitting a separate factual part.
rubric_policy.review_design: Descriptive AI semantic review after seeing output, not a new prospective benchmark or independent human acceptance.
